AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS IAM/STS access key with securityagent:List* / BatchGet* permissions. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value or the container's IAM role.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS IAM/STS secret paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form.

AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.description: STS session token when using AssumeRole / SSO credentials (keys prefixed 'ASIA...'). Omit for long-lived IAM users.

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region for the securityagent client. Default 'us-east-1'.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_AGENT_SPACE.description: Restrict the walk to a single agent space id (as-<uuid>). Omit to iterate every agent space in the account.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_PENTEST_ID.description: Restrict the walk to a single pentest id (pt-<uuid>). Omit to iterate every pentest in each agent space.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_JOB_ID.description: Restrict the walk to a single pentest job id (pj-<uuid>). Omit to iterate every completed job.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'findings,endpoints'. Valid: findings (BatchGetFindings -> Faraday vulns), endpoints (ListDiscoveredEndpoints -> info-level records), jobs (BatchGetPentestJobs overview -> info-level record).

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MAX_SPACES.description: Hard cap on agent spaces iterated. Default 20.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MAX_PENTESTS.description: Per-space cap on pentests iterated. Default 20.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MAX_JOBS.description: Per-pentest cap on pentest jobs iterated. Default 20.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'info' (keep everything). securityagent's UNKNOWN + INFORMATIONAL risk levels both map to 'info'.

AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_ONLY_COMPLETED.description: Skip pentest jobs whose status is not COMPLETED. Default 'true'. Set to 'false' to include IN_PROGRESS / FAILED / CANCELED jobs.

name: aws_security_agent
title: AWS Security Agent
description: AWS Security Agent (GA, boto3 securityagent client, api version 2025-09-06) pentest findings + discovered endpoints import. Walks ListAgentSpaces -> ListPentests -> ListPentestJobsForPentest (COMPLETED by default) -> BatchGetPentestJobs (target endpoint + overview) -> ListFindings + BatchGetFindings (rich detail) -> ListDiscoveredEndpoints. Each finding becomes a Faraday vuln on the pentest's target host (parsed from the job's endpoints[0].uri, e.g. 'corp-dev-4.apps-dev.faradaysec.com'), with description + attackScript folded into the desc, evidence/impact/poc into data, remediation/recommendation into resolution, and CVSS/riskType/confidence + agent-space/pentest/job ids as refs. Discovered endpoints (URI + operation + evidence + description) become info-level records on the same host. Auth uses the standard AWS credential chain: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (+ optional AWS_SESSION_TOKEN for STS/SSO), the IAM role attached to the dispatcher container, or the IMDS if unset. Filter with AWS_SECURITY_AGENT_AGENT_SPACE / _PENTEST_ID / _JOB_ID to pin to one target. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent.
